notes: Targets: ids-model-check zip.mjs/xml.mjs/bcf.mjs (never campaigned; 1.5 s suite). Hunted by validating the BCF export against buildingSMART BCF-XML release_2_1 schemas with xmllint: every markup.bcf failed on IfcProject="". Guard added: eval/fetch-bcf-schemas.sh + an XSD test in engine.test.mjs (skips without schemas/xmllint), plus schema-free tests for the IfcProject attribute and XML-forbidden characters. Follow-up for a control-plane PR: have the ids-model-check CI step run eval/fetch-bcf-schemas.sh (alongside the open 2026-11-16 fetch-testcases entry). Verification: node --test engine.test.mjs 32 pass; run_venture_tests.py ids-model-check ok (128 tests); both defect tests and the XSD test fail on the old bcf.mjs.

real_defects.issue: Every markup.bcf in the BCF export wrote <File IfcProject="">; BCF 2.1 markup.xsd types IfcProject as IfcGuid (length 22), so every topic file failed schema validation (xmllint against buildingSMART/BCF-XML release_2_1 markup.xsd: N of N fail). Fixed by dropping the optional attribute (the report carries no project GlobalId); all 9 files of the sample export now validate.

xml() escaped & < > " but kept C0 control characters and lone surrogates; an IFC name with STEP \X\07 (decodeStepString gives U+0007) or a 250-char title cut through a surrogate pair made markup.bcf not well-formed XML, so BIM tools reject the topic. Fixed by dropping characters XML 1.0 cannot hold.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
